facts.fact: A driving licence can be renewed within one year before (or after) its expiry, as per the amended CMV Act
facts.quote: When should I apply for Renewal of Driving License? As per the latest amendment of CMV Act, renewal of a driving License could be done within one year prior to or after the expiry of the Driving License.

facts.fact: A commercial (transport) driving licence is valid for 5 years from the date of issue
facts.quote: What will be the validity of Public Service Vehicle badge? commercial Driving license is valid for 5 years from the date of issue.
facts.note: MV Act s.14(2)(a) (indiacode consolidated text) also says a transport-vehicle licence is effective for five years.

summary: One-year-before/after renewal window and 5-year commercial licence validity confirmed on the Parivahan FAQ; expected answer unchanged.
